Lessons.Title: Using Algorithms with Partial Products: 2 Two-digit Numbers
ExplanationParagraphs:
Learning goal: You will use partial products in an algorithm to multiply 2 two-digit numbers.
In the previous lesson, you learned to record the partial products from multiplying vertically, using an algorithm. You made connections between the new notation to the structure of the rectangular diagram on which you used earlier.
Core relationship: Multiply two two-digit numbers with an algorithm. Multiply both ones and tens contributions and add aligned partial products.

Local publisher 2021 source lesson activities: Warm-up:  Number Talk: Products	 (10 minutes); Activity 1:  Partial Products, Recorded	 (25 minutes); Activity 2:  Han’s Multiplication Mishap	 (10 minutes); Cool-down:  Choose Your Own Strategy	 (5 minutes)
Original visual/physical and peer-explanation activities still require teacher review.

CommonMistakes.Mistake: Omitting the tens row's factor ten in partial products.
CommonMistakes.WhyWrong: It changes the unit, place value, or operation.
CommonMistakes.Correction: Multiply both ones and tens contributions and add aligned partial products.
